An '''Imperial Cash Voucher''' was a form of currency in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Destabilization]] agent [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kerri Lessev/Legends|Kerri Lessev]] carried an Imperial Cash Voucher with an unlimited limit.<ref name="CRO">[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]</ref>
